# `alloc::btree_set` — declaration reference

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../stdlib/alloc/btree_set.lani#L5)

Layer: `alloc`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Ordered set on alloc::btree_map's B+ tree (keys of a map with a zero-sized value). tree_set representative rules: try_insert keeps the stored equal key and returns the supplied one, try_replace returns the displaced one. Union/intersection/difference/symmetric difference are two linear merges (count, then an exactly sized build); left representatives win, operands may alias, Err allocates nothing. Errors are alloc::btree_map::Error and SinkError. Checked against alloc::tree_set on native Linux x86_64.
